reading.body:
Digital Fortress Portland 3 in Beaverton, Oregon, publishes no capacity figure, making it impossible to assess whether it contributes meaningfully to Oregon's AI infrastructure or remains dormant.

The facility exists as one of at least two Digital Fortress locations within 50 meters of each other in the same corporate park, suggesting either a two-building campus or a data entry error. No operator website responds to connection attempts, and no independent reporting describes the facility. Oregon has mapped 133 data center facilities statewide but only 156.6 megawatts of disclosed IT load, a ratio indicating most capacity in the state remains undeclared. This facility typifies that opacity.

For AI scaling purposes, the distinction between a 5-megawatt and 50-megawatt facility is material. Without published capacity, power draw, or equipment specifications, this location cannot be ranked among Oregon's disclosed capacity or evaluated for its role in supporting accelerators, storage, or other infrastructure. Future assessment depends on operator disclosure or independent reporting, neither currently available.
